roles.role: Business Analyst (AI Products, Ensure Safe Production)

highlights.text: Shipped a Gen AI agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio that auto-summarises shift reports, cutting shift-handover summary time by 60%.

Own product strategy and roadmap for the Ensure Safe Production portfolio; led global market assessments across 30 assets and 40+ vendors (3 AI-native), turning asset feedback and vendor insights into a prioritised investment roadmap of $2M per year.

Built and scaled a Shell-owned risk-visualisation product from 0 to 1 (vision, requirements, alignment, delivery), replacing a well-known, long-standing third-party tool with potential savings of $15K per site per year.
Product SME and lead for the S/4HANA transformation at 4 upstream and gas assets; owned requirements, integration readiness and validation for 3 business-critical apps, reducing delivery risk.
Conceived and scaled the PMQA quality platform 4x, from 400+ to 1,600+ projects, serving ~40,000 stakeholders across global PwC.
Introduced an ML engine that flags risky projects, cutting Quality Associates' audit cycle time by 30% while improving accuracy.
Led a 15-member product team through 10 product increments, 8 releases and 20+ sprints.
Integrated 12 systems surfacing 200+ KPIs on 50+ Power BI dashboards used by project teams to monitor project quality.
Turned Quality leadership's vision into a 220+ story backlog and drove global feature adoption through demos and webcasts.
Assessed five growth areas using competitive intelligence, shaping an expansion roadmap that targeted a 25% market-share gain.
Scaled 4 internal enterprise products to 260K+ associates, including one that became the most used in a 150+ app ecosystem.
Led 200+ M&A due-diligence assessments for the BFS vertical on financial and technology fit; advanced 15+ deals to final stage.
Evaluated 300+ FinTech startups across blockchain, payments and compliance to source strategic partnerships.
Scrum Master for 50+ sprints, improving release cadence and delivery reliability.
Built a digital recruitment platform, reducing onboarding time by 90%.
